issue.title: Bug: drop_packets/test_configurable_drop_counters.py failed because FDB verification uses hyphenated MAC format

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

`drop_packets/test_configurable_drop_counters.py::test_neighbor_link_down`
failed during FDB programming verification.

The test creates a static FDB entry using a MAC address in hyphenated format,
for example:
`72-06-00-01-00-40`

Then apply_fdb_config() verifies the operation using:
`show mac | grep -i 72-06-00-01-00-40 | wc -l`
However, show mac displays MAC addresses in colon-separated format:
`<IPV6>`

Because the verification greps for the hyphenated form, the test does not find
the entry and fails with:
`Failed: FDB SET operation for 72-06-00-01-00-40 was not applied`

### Steps to Reproduce

Run the configurable drop counters test on a dualtor testbed:

```
sudo ./run_tests.sh -n dtAA56 -m individual -p drop_packets \
      -r -t any,util,dualtor,t0 \
      -f ../ansible/testbed.yaml -u \
      -c "drop_packets/test_configurable_drop_counters.py::test_neighbor_link_down"
```

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

 **Actual behavior:**
  The test fails while verifying that the FDB SET operation was applied:
`  Failed: FDB SET operation for 72-06-00-01-00-40 was not applied`

  **Expected behavior:**
  Then the FDB verification should detect the programmed entry correctly.

### Relevant log output

```shell
Failed: FDB SET operation for 72-06-00-01-00-40 was not applied
```

### Output of `show version`

```shell
os_version: branch.202605-ars.f2e092bc-buildimage.17a11c3c9aa389a1e836d56151305c1e33c26d62-nightly-2026.06.24.14.40
platform: x86_64-arista_7260cx3_64
hwsku: Arista-7260CX3-C64
asic: broadcom
```

### Attach files (if any)

[test_configurable_drop_counters.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29574003/test_configurable_drop_counters.log)
[test_configurable_drop_counters.xml](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29574004/test_configurable_drop_counters.xml)

resolution.title: Fix FDB verification MAC format
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes #25831

The configurable drop counters test programs static FDB entries with hyphenated MAC addresses, but show mac displays MAC addresses in colon-separated format.
The verification path greps show mac using the original hyphenated MAC address, so it can miss an FDB entry that was applied successfully and fail with:

FDB SET operation for <mac> was not applied

Normalize the MAC address to the show mac format before checking the FDB entry.

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Avoid a false failure in  drop_packets/test_configurable_drop_counters.py::test_neighbor_link_down
caused by a MAC address format mismatch.

The test programs the FDB entry with a hyphenated MAC address, for example:

`  72-06-00-01-00-40`
But show mac reports the entry using colon-separated format:

  `<IPV6>`

#### How did you do it?
Converted the MAC address from hyphen-separated format to colon-separated
  format before grepping show mac.

#### How did you verify/test it?

##### Failure before the fix:

  drop_packets/test_configurable_drop_counters.py::test_neighbor_link_down[PORT_INGRESS_DROPS-L3_EGRESS_LINK_DOWN]
  `Failed: FDB SET operation for 72-06-00-01-00-40 was not applied`

 Validation after the fix passed in repeated runs of:

 drop_packets/test_configurable_drop_counters.py::test_neighbor_link_down[PORT_INGRESS_DROPS-L3_EGRESS_LINK_DOWN]
